strings.{{observed}} у остановки чуть не провали: On {{observed}}, I nearly fell into an open manhole near the bus stop. The cover was still missing this morning. Children use this path to get to school. I was told: “The appeal will be examined within a month.” What should we do until then?
strings.Авиакомпания отменила единственный рейс: The airline cancelled the only flight on my ticket. I declined to travel because of the cancellation, but they said the fare was non-refundable and I could only get a voucher.
The bus near my home now runs much less often. Also, a district institution posted my telephone number and health information on a public page. I put both issues in one letter. Do I now have to write two new ones?
strings.Аппарат Совета депутатов муниципального: Staff of the Council of Deputies of Nizhegorodsky Municipal District
strings.Банк включил меня в страхование. Кредит: The bank enrolled me in insurance. I repaid the loan in full early. They charged forty thousand for everything, and now they say I must wait until the insurer sends the money to the bank.
The bank sold me a policy with the loan. I am the policyholder in the contract. I cancelled on the twentieth day, but they quote the old fourteen-day rule and are waiting for the bank's decision.
strings.Больничный закрыли, но выплаты нет. Мне: My sick leave was closed, but there is no payment. They say ten days, and I count from the closure date. In my account I can see that the employer sent the information later.
strings.В МФЦ мне выдали отказ. Я думал, это зна: The MFC handed me a refusal. I thought that meant my documents had never been accepted. But the receipt has an acceptance number, and the refusal bears another authority's signature.
strings.В МФЦ отказались принять мой пакет. На ж: The MFC refused to accept my package. Their response to my complaint says it is an ordinary letter and I can wait thirty days. But I am challenging the refusal to accept documents.
My surname has a typo in the EGRN extract. The document used to make the entry spells it correctly. They told me to wait a month for an ordinary reply.
strings.В выписке неправильная характеристика. М: The extract has an incorrect characteristic. I was told every such error is corrected in three days. I brought a corrected plan.
strings.В готовом документе неверная буква в фам: There is a wrong letter in my surname in the completed document. The MFC accepted my correction application and forwarded it. Then the authority that issued the document refused. I brought the complaint back to the MFC.
strings.В документе, который выдал МФЦ в рамках: A document the MFC issued within its authority contains a typo. My original information is correct. The employee refused to correct it: “Read more carefully before collection.”
strings.В канцелярии поступило бумажное письмо:: The correspondence office has received a paper letter: the sheet got wet and the main text cannot be read. The surname and postal address are legible on the envelope and in the heading. The duty officer shows the original and a good-quality copy.
strings.В листке стоит 60 тысяч, а последний пер: The payslip says 60 thousand, but the last transfer was just over 32 thousand. Does that mean I was underpaid by almost half?
strings.В личном кабинете подробно описал пробле: I described the problem in detail in my account. The supplementary photo would not open, and the employee suggested deleting the entire letter.
strings.В одном письме я написал о маршруте авто: In one letter I wrote about the bus route and publication of my child's medical data. The whole letter, including the medical attachments, was sent to the transport authority.
strings.В окне отказались принимать пакет: попро: The counter refused to accept my package and asked for another certificate. It is not in the published list. I want to challenge the refusal to accept documents, not ask you to approve the service.
strings.В письме я указал московский адрес предп: I gave the enterprise's Moscow address in my letter. They suggested sending it to the directorate for Moscow Region. Is that definitely the right authority? I do not want the letter sent round in circles again.
strings.В помещении указан ассортимент и цены, с: The premises display the range and prices, including beer. I consider any such line to be alcohol advertising.
strings.В приёмную поступил бумажный лист без фа: The reception office received a paper sheet without a surname or reply address. It states a place, the time of an alleged dangerous act, and details of the person carrying it out. In this case, you ask the duty officer questions about the materials, not the unknown author.
strings.В рекламе внутри магазина написано преду: The advertisement inside the shop contains a warning. Why do they say that its mere presence is not enough?
strings.В решении перепутали одну букву моей фам: One letter in my surname is wrong in the judgment. My passport details and everything else are correct. I was told that because there is an error, the administration must cancel the judgment.
They are removing staircase parts in an old building. The noticeboard says “roof repair”. The building seems to be protected. I am not against repairs, but what will happen to the staircase?
strings.Вижу один автобус с раннего утра до позд: I see the same bus from early morning until late evening. I think the driver works without rest. I sent the vehicle number—isn't that enough for a fine?
strings.Во дворе спиливают деревья. Рабочие пока: Trees are being felled in the courtyard. The workers show a paper, but it seems to refer to a different plot. Someone in the chat has already written that everything is permitted.
strings.Водитель ни разу не отдыхал сорок пять м: The driver never rested for forty-five minutes in a row. There were fifteen minutes, then thirty. I believe such separate parts never count.
strings.Вуз показывает аккредитацию. Но я поступ: The university shows its accreditation. But I am applying for another field of study that I cannot see in the extract.
strings.Вчера у остановки не было крышки люка. С: Yesterday a manhole cover was missing near the stop. Today they sent a photograph showing it back in place. But the metal barrier is still across the path, and I cannot get through with a pushchair.
strings.Вы в прошлый раз выясняли, чей это колод: Last time you were finding out who owned this manhole. I brought a letter from the service: its number matches the diagram. But the cover is still missing, and the dispatcher says your department must forward the request.
strings.Государственный гражданский служащий, на: State civil servant assigned to handle the submission
strings.Дежурный передаёт письмо: текст напечата: The duty officer passes on a letter: the text is clearly printed, and a surname and address are present, but the material does not reveal what proposal, application or complaint has been submitted. There are no annexes or references to another case.
strings.Дежурный сотрудник приёмной органа здрав: Duty reception employee at a health authority
strings.Дежурный специалист публичной приёмной: Duty officer at the public reception office
strings.Детское питание оказалось просроченным у: The baby food was already expired when purchased. The paper receipt was lost, and the shop refused to discuss a refund.
strings.Документы приняли, но потом попросили пр: My documents were accepted, but later they asked me to bring a paper certificate. It is not on the list. The employee said this was more convenient than making an interagency request.
strings.Документы приняли, расписку выдали. Но в: My documents were accepted and a receipt issued. But the body says the package has not arrived from the multifunctional service centre. The register extract shows that the forwarding deadline has passed. I am complaining about the centre employee's delay in forwarding it.
strings.Жалуюсь на бездействие пристава. В приём: I am complaining about a bailiff's failure to act. Reception told me to wait the standard thirty days, but I saw ten in the law. I am also considering going to court—would that change things?
strings.Живу в Москве, но на даче в Тверской обл: I live in Moscow, but at my dacha in Tver Oblast I saw smoke from a waste site. I wrote to a Moscow body. Their reply suggested locating the site using my home address.
strings.Живу в Москве, но обращаюсь о площадке в: I live in Moscow, but my appeal concerns a site in another region. They suggested a Moscow district department. The attachment includes information on the supervised facility.
strings.Замок заменили, но к выходу не пройти: в: The lock was replaced, but I cannot get to the exit: the whole corridor is full of boxes and trolleys. They only send me a report about a new door handle.
strings.Зарплату задержали. Вчера пришёл перевод: My wages were delayed. A transfer arrived yesterday and my employer said there was now nothing to complain about. But the payslip shows a larger amount.
strings.Заявление в личном кабинете появилось да: The application appeared in my online account a long time ago. I signed it later, but the waiting period starts when it appeared, right?
strings.Заявление на исправление приняли и согла: They accepted my correction application and acknowledged the typo. The period specified in the regulations has passed. They tell me: 'There has been no refusal, so there is nothing to complain about.'
strings.Кафе отключило музыку, но дома по-прежне: The café switched off the music, but there is still a hum in my home. The response says there is no longer any disturbance of the peace.
strings.Кнопка вызова работает, но сотрудник гов: The call button works, but the employee says I still have to go upstairs. There is no lift. I am willing to talk here if privacy can be ensured.
strings.Кнопка у школы снова не работает. Мне пр: The button by the school is not working again. They sent a photograph of a green signal, but it is another corner of the junction. Our children still cross by guesswork.
strings.Когда оформляла карту, я отдельно соглас: When I applied for the card, I separately agreed to promotional SMS. Later I asked them to stop. They replied: we already have your signature, so the messages will continue.
strings.Коллега увидел фамилию заявителя и предл: A colleague saw the applicant's surname and proposed removing me from the case immediately: we have the same surname. But this is the first time we have met.
strings.Консультант публичной приёмной по защите: Public reception adviser on passenger rights
strings.Контейнеры обещали у дома, а поставили н: They promised containers by our building but placed them on the neighbouring plot. The reply says the site is already in the register.
strings.Кредит полностью погасил досрочно через: I repaid the whole loan early after a few months. I am the policyholder in the policy. They told me that thirty days had passed, so nothing could be refunded.
strings.Купила продукт, а срок на упаковке уже з: I bought a product whose package expiry date had already passed. The shop shows a product document, but the batch number is different. They refunded me; I am reporting the goods that remain on sale.
strings.Купили саженцы из питомника. Продавец по: We bought saplings from a nursery. The seller showed a certificate, but its batch number does not match the consignment note. He says one document is enough for the whole season.
strings.Лаборатория не нашла вредителя. Продавец: The laboratory found no pest. The seller thinks that this report is the quarantine certificate.
strings.Между нашим домом и остановкой раскопали: The pavement between our building and the stop has been dug up. A permit hangs on the fence, but with a pushchair the only route left is along the road. Does a permit make that acceptable?
strings.Мелкий текст я не различаю. Можно прочит: I cannot make out the small print. Could you read it to me somewhere private? My daughter came with me, but I make my own decisions.
strings.Мне говорят, что на мой вопрос уже трижд: They say my question has been answered three times. But the first letter only gives an incoming number, the second says where it was forwarded, and the third says it is still under review. Where is the answer to the actual question?
strings.Мне дали направление, но сказали: мест н: I was given a referral, but they said there were no slots and I should book a paid appointment. I am not asking you to treat me; I want to understand how to get care under my policy.
strings.Мне дважды присылали письма о регистраци: They sent me two registration letters but never answered whether the passage would be restored. Today they proposed ending correspondence, saying they had already sent two responses.
strings.Мне написали, что площадку проверили. Хо: They wrote that the site had been inspected. I want to see the report. They refused access to the entire folder, saying it supposedly contains other people's personal information.
strings.Мне не нравится постановление суда. Прош: I disagree with the court ruling. Please have your administration overturn it and state that it does not need to be enforced. I thought any superior authority could review a decision.
strings.Мне нужно восстановить дорожку и провери: I need the path restored and an investigation into why the inspector reported completion when no work had been done. They assigned the whole letter to him again.
strings.Мне нужны решение о бюджете на {{caseYea: I need the decision on the {{caseYear}} budget and its appendices. My neighbour says officials must always send certified scans and cannot reply with a link. So far, I have submitted an ordinary request through the electronic form.
strings.Мне объяснили, что мой пакет не отправля: They explained that my package was held under the centre's uniform procedure. The employee showed an order: all such applications are kept until Friday. I challenge this centre procedure, not the specialist's personal conduct.
strings.Мне ответили, что это просто вывеска. Но: They replied that it is just a sign. But the screen now shows more than the shop name: a different promotion appears every minute. And at night it shines into my bedroom.
strings.Мне отказали в услуге: сказали, что друг: I was refused the service: they said another agency had not answered their request. I submitted all my documents. Now they suggest that I visit those agencies myself and collect certificates.
strings.Мне оформили больничный по уходу за ребё: I was issued sick leave to care for my child. HR said they would pay three days themselves, just as when I am ill. Is that correct?
strings.Мне показали красивый документ с печатью: They showed me an impressive stamped document and said it permitted all restoration work. But it does not mention our building.
strings.Мне показали отдельное согласие на публи: They showed me separate consent for publishing celebration photos. But the website has a health-restrictions table next to the children’s names. Does signing for a photo allow that too?
strings.Мне предложили курс повышения квалификац: I was offered a professional development course, but I could not find its state accreditation. Does that mean the teaching is unlawful?
strings.Мне прислали акт, что опасную партию убр: They sent me a record saying the dangerous batch was removed. But the shelf label and my submission show a different number. Can the issue be considered resolved?
strings.Мне прислали акт: работы завершены. Но а: They sent me a record saying the work is complete. But the pavement still has no asphalt and slabs remain near the building. I do not understand exactly what was accepted.
strings.Мне прислали ссылку на платную запись. Н: They sent me a paid-booking link. There probably are no free slots at all. But there is also some attachment in the message; I have not opened it.
strings.Мне сказали, что жалобу на пристава не р: I was told that my complaint about the bailiff would not be considered on its merits. But my surname is printed at the end! I brought a paper copy and forgot to sign it.
strings.Мне сказали, что ходатайство уже рассмот: They told me the motion has already been considered. The log contains a ruling, but no copy was sent to anyone. They suggest waiting another ten days.
strings.Мне уже отвечали две организации. Сейчас: Two organisations have already replied to me. I came to your authority now because the earlier letters involve different powers. Here they say there will be no new response because correspondence on this topic already exists.
strings.Мы просили поставить контейнеры. Нам отв: We requested containers. They replied that containers were pointless without collection, although a contract and route already exist.
strings.Мы просим улучшить доступ к дому. Я пред: We are asking for better access to our building. I represent the initiative group. Give us every neighbour’s medical information too; we will attach it to our proposal.
strings.Мы хотим раздельный сбор во дворе. Предс: We want separate waste collection in our courtyard. A representative offered to install coloured containers free of charge but said nothing about collection. The neighbours are already expecting an opening announcement.
strings.На встрече все поддержали навес у остано: Everyone at the meeting supported a shelter at the bus stop. Does that mean the administration must install it by next week?
strings.На входе я отказался открыть сумку. Охра: At the entrance I refused to open my bag. The guard said that he was now entitled to hold me until I agreed.
strings.На отдельно стоящем щите реклама пива. Д: There is a beer advertisement on a freestanding billboard. The owner says it is 180 metres from the school. He insists it is all legal because it is more than a hundred metres away. Are there no other conditions?
strings.На первом листе письма одна фраза: «Прош: The first page contains one sentence: “Please investigate; everything is in the attachment.” An employee thinks the subject is unclear. The duty officer shows the attached document with a specific address, event and request.
strings.На площадке стоит контейнер для вторсырь: There is a recycling container at the site. Residents propose putting lamps and batteries into it together with packaging.
strings.На подъезде написано, что будут работы с: There is a notice at the entrance saying works will involve a shutdown. A smell appeared today. My neighbour says it must be because of the repairs and there is no need to report it.
strings.На пустыре сейчас горит мусор. Я видел э: Rubbish is burning on the vacant lot right now. I saw it from home. I don't know whose land it is. Must the owner be found first?
strings.На сайте отчёт о занятиях: сколько учени: The website has a report on activities: how many pupils chose each area. I saw the table and thought the school had published children’s data. Can I demand that any statistics be removed?
strings.На сайте реестра я дом не нашёл. Подрядч: I could not find the building on the register website. The contractor says that without a register number it needs no permit from the protection authority. But the neighbours have a document showing it is an identified asset.
strings.На сайте школы есть лицензия, а в догово: The school's website shows a licence, but the contract names another legal entity. They have the same name.
strings.На стенде срок работ уже закончился. А л: The work period on the board has expired, but people are still working. I photographed the old sheet—please stop everything immediately.
strings.На стенде старая копия лицензии. Я решил: There is an old licence copy on the noticeboard. I concluded that the security operation is now unlawful.
strings.На упаковке старая дата. Я решил, что эт: The package has an old date. I thought it was the expiry date and wrote that the shop sells expired food.
strings.На школьном сайте выложили список детей: The school website published a list of children with surnames and health information. When I asked for it to be removed, they said, “You signed consent.” They suggest discussing it in the shared parents’ chat. I do not want the data spreading further.
strings.На экране контур дома съехал. Наверное,: The house outline has shifted on the screen. You must have rewritten my plot's coordinates. Correct them today.
strings.Над входом в магазин светятся название и: The shop name and opening hours glow above the entrance. At night the child's room is as bright as daytime. They replied that it is a sign, not advertising, so there can be no issue.
strings.Назовите это опечаткой и перенесите гран: Call it a typo and move the boundary. My neighbour disagrees, but it would be more convenient for me.
strings.Нам поставили по одиннадцать часов за ру: They scheduled eleven hours behind the wheel for us in advance. The last two hours were called “reaching the parking place,” citing the driver's right to extend driving.
strings.Ночью резали трубу. Прошу наказать работ: They cut a pipe at night. Please punish the workers for the noise—it was nighttime.
strings.Ночью шумят у кафе. Я уже сообщал, но те: There is noise outside the café at night. I reported it before, but now I also complain about how the previous call was handled. I am afraid everything will simply be handed to the same employee.
The authority says the result has been ready for a long time. The MFC received it, but every time I ask, they say the documents are still under review. Yesterday I saw the entry recording its arrival at the centre.
strings.Организация из обращения должна мне день: The organization mentioned in the submission owes me money under a personal loan. I am drafting the decision on its matter. I have no relatives there, so there is no conflict, right?
strings.Оставил номер в магазине, а теперь прихо: I left my number at a shop, and now I get advertising messages. I am sure they sold the database. I want those responsible punished and the messages to stop.
strings.Охранник предъявил мне требование, но от: The guard made a demand of me but refused to show his certificate, saying he did not have to show it to visitors.
strings.Питомник находится в районе, где объявил: The nursery is in a district where quarantine was announced. Does that mean every seller must have this certificate?
strings.Пишу снова про те же светильники. Новых: I am writing again about the same lights. I have no new photographs, but I disagree with the earlier responses. The reception office said that because this is my fourth letter, it can be deleted immediately.
There is nowhere to sit on the way to the clinic. I drew locations for two benches and a small canopy. I am not asking for anyone to be punished. Could this idea be considered?
strings.Подала обычную декларацию 3-НДФЛ на выче: I filed an ordinary 3-NDFL return for a deduction. I counted 90 days in the app, but the inspectorate gave a different date. My reception letter was even later—which date should count?
strings.Подрядчик показывает разрешение на работ: The contractor is showing a permit for work on a tree. But it says branch pruning, while only a stump is left on site. Does any document like that authorise everything?
strings.Получил судебный приказ и не согласен с: I received a payment order and disagree with collection. I sent it to the administration for cancellation. That is the same as submitting objections to the judge, isn't it?
strings.После ветра крупная повреждённая ветка в: After the wind, a large damaged branch is hanging over the passage to the building. I submitted a letter, but nobody has restricted access yet. Must we wait for a reply to the letter?
strings.После моей жалобы подсветку отключили. С: After my complaint, the lighting was switched off. The light no longer bothers me, but now there is a constant hum from a unit on the wall. Please do not close the entire letter.
strings.После первого отказа я исправил единстве: After the first refusal, I corrected the only error listed. Now, after accepting the package, they have given me a new list. The original documents have not changed in the meantime. The employee says, “We only noticed it now.”
strings.После получения документа я сменил фамил: I changed my surname after receiving the document. I asked for the old surname to be corrected as a typo, but the body refused. I think they should simply replace one line for free.
strings.Посылка из-за границы не движется. На фо: My parcel from abroad is not moving. A forum says customs holds everything for months. Tracking shows “release authorised” and then postal processing.
strings.Почта сказала, что всё у таможни. В прош: The postal service said everything is with customs. Last time you advised checking with the operator, but now I have a different notification.
strings.Пришло письмо «Ваше обращение доставлено: I received an email saying “Your appeal has been delivered”. Does that mean my request has already been granted? There is no decision in my account.
strings.Приём заявления в территориальном органе: Application intake at a territorial rights-registration authority
strings.Приёмная муниципального органа – операто: Reception office of a municipal authority acting as data controller
strings.Приёмная органа власти Москвы: Reception office of a Moscow public authority
strings.Приёмная органа исполнительной власти Мо: Reception office of a Moscow executive authority
strings.Приёмная руководителя учебного департаме: Reception office of the simulated department director
strings.Приёмная управы района Москвы: Reception office of a Moscow district administration
strings.Приёмная учредителя МФЦ: Reception office of the MFC's founder
strings.Прошло почти три месяца после первой дек: It has been almost three months since my first return. But later I changed the amount and filed an amended one. Count from the first anyway.
strings.Прошу принятое решение о бюджете вместе: I request the adopted budget decision together with its appendices. The draft response gives me the homepage link. But there I found only a meeting announcement and an old draft.
strings.Прошу проверить действия подрядчика. Я н: Please examine the contractor's actions. I do not know who handles this in your office, but I want the documents examined impartially. The contract and correspondence are attached.
strings.Прямой тротуар перекрыли, теперь нужно о: The direct pavement was blocked, so now we have to go around. Does that mean the barrier is unlawful? I want it removed immediately.
strings.Работодатель получил отказ по пособию, а: My employer received the benefit refusal, but I found out by chance. There is no decision in my account. Must they send it to me?
strings.Работодатель убрал из табеля два часа на: The employer removed two hours at the terminus from my timesheet because the bus was stationary. But I was waiting for boarding and remained at work. Does that count as rest?
strings.Раньше тут горел мусор. Сейчас дыма нет,: Rubbish used to burn here. There is no smoke now, but the dump remains. Can my appeal be closed using the fire-extinguishing certificate?
strings.Раньше я отдельно разрешала публикацию и: I previously gave separate permission to publish my child’s name and photograph. Later I asked for dissemination to stop; the school received the appeal, but the photograph remained in the public album.
strings.Рейс задержали. Претензию отправила рань: The flight was delayed. I sent the claim before the airline received it. They also sent an automatic reply—is that already a decision?
strings.Рекламу пива разместили в интернете, но: A beer advertisement was placed online with an 18+ label above it. The representative believes that this is sufficient.
strings.Решение я не оспариваю, но всю сумму сей: I do not challenge the judgment, but I cannot pay the whole amount now. Can the administration let me pay monthly and tell the bailiff to do nothing for the time being?
strings.Руководитель уже передал обращение друго: The manager has already reassigned the submission to another employee because of my personal connection. But the new employee is asking me to secretly write the draft for him.
strings.С направлением я пришла в поликлинику, у: I brought a referral to a clinic participating in compulsory health insurance. They said a policy from another region was not accepted here and offered a paid appointment.
strings.Сайт пишет «вручено», но я ничего не пол: The website says “delivered”, but I received nothing. That means they gave my parcel to someone else.
strings.Светофор работает, но мне кажется, зелён: The traffic light works, but I think green is too short. Please add ten seconds immediately. Can you do that by your instruction?
strings.Семь часов ждали посадки. Воду дали, гор: We waited seven hours to board. They gave us water but no hot meal. The representative said the delay was due to weather, so the airline owed us nothing.
strings.Сигнал несколько вечеров пропадает после: The signal has disappeared after eleven on several evenings. The reply says they checked at noon and everything works. Do I have to go out filming at night again?
strings.Снаружи дверь запасного выхода не открыл: The emergency-exit door would not open from outside. It has a keyhole. Does that mean the exit is definitely blocked and we must immediately break the lock?
strings.Сначала отправил вопрос на найденный ema: I first sent my question to an email address I found, then submitted it through the official service with identity verification. The confirmation has a date. Which date starts the registration period?
strings.Снова пишу о той трубе. Знакомый прислал: I am writing again about that pipe. An acquaintance sent me a photo and I forwarded it as today’s. Only now did I notice the file seems to have been made last year.

strings.Справка не обязательна: орган может запр: The certificate is not mandatory: the authority can request it itself. I had already obtained it and brought it voluntarily. The authority's reception office said that because inter-agency exchange exists, they have no right to accept my document at all.
strings.Теперь всю задержанную зарплату перевели: All the delayed wages have now been transferred. Accounting says the debt is settled and there is nothing more to write about. But I also asked about compensation for the delay.
strings.Теперь посылка у меня, но упаковка повре: I have the parcel now, but the packaging is damaged and some contents are missing. They only tell me that customs released everything.
strings.Тогда специалисты уже приезжали. Сейчас: The specialists already came then. There is no smell now. I want to know what they did about my call: the reply only says it is closed.
strings.У Коломенского заметил тёмную воду у тру: Near Kolomenskoye I noticed dark water by a pipe and a strong smell. There is a business nearby; it is probably dumping everything. Please punish those responsible immediately. I brought a photograph and marked the location on a plan.
strings.У входа в клуб меня задержал охранник. Н: A guard detained me at the club entrance. His uniform had the club's emblem, but the administrator showed a licence issued to a different company. Is it definitely a forgery, or can that happen?
strings.У выхода Э-5 стоял человек с ключом и го: A person with a key stood by exit Э-5 and told us to wait for them. In response, they sent a record saying everything opens. But the photograph shows a completely different door.
strings.У дома срубили два дерева. Мне разрешени: Two trees near the building were cut down. Nobody showed me a permit, so I am sure they worked without one. The authority has sent documents; please help me understand them.
strings.У меня собака-проводник. Документ о её о: I have a guide dog. I showed its training document, but the security guard pointed to the “No animals” sign.
strings.У обозначенного эвакуационного выхода дв: The door at the marked evacuation exit is locked. Security say they have the key one floor below. There is no smoke now, but many people are in the hall.
strings.У перехода не видно зелёного сигнала. Сл: The green signal cannot be seen at the crossing. The service said the electronics work and closed the report. But branches still hide the traffic light.
strings.У продавца не оказалось бумажного карант: The seller did not have a paper quarantine certificate. Can an electronic record really replace it?
strings.Утром мне показали акт: нарушений нет. Н: In the morning they showed me a report: no violations. But I complained about light after midnight, and in the morning the screen is always off.
strings.Хочу отказаться от страховки при кредите: I want to withdraw from the insurance linked to my loan. The insurer sends me to the bank, and the bank sends me back. The contract names the bank as policyholder, while I am included in the list of insured persons.
strings.Хочу предложить скамейку у остановки. Мн: I want to suggest a bench near the bus stop. They said my letter would only be accepted with signatures from most residents. For now, I am writing on my own behalf.
strings.Я болел восемь дней. Работодатель перевё: I was ill for eight days. My employer transferred money for three days and says everything is paid. Where is the rest?
strings.Я жалуюсь на начальника отдела: он не ра: I am complaining about the head of the division: he did not consider my arguments. The reception office says they will send the complaint to him because he knows the case best. Who will then examine his own actions?
strings.Я жалуюсь на сотрудника отдела. Руководи: I am complaining about an employee of the division. The head suggested that the employee prepare and sign the final response personally. But it is that employee's actions I am writing about.
strings.Я живу в Москве, а шум слышала на даче в: I live in Moscow, but I heard the noise at my country house in Moscow Oblast. I gave my Moscow city address in the submission.
strings.Я записался в центр задолго до визита. О: I booked at the centre long before the visit. Many days have passed since booking, but the service is not ready. The employee says they started counting only after accepting the application.
strings.Я написал адрес своего дома. Но провал з: I wrote my home address. But I noticed the collapse while returning from a friend's place. I have a photograph, although it does not show the exact house number. For some reason, the dispatcher sent the request to my entrance.
strings.Я написал всё в личном кабинете неделю н: I wrote everything in my account a week ago. Today I noticed the “Send” button and pressed it. Has the deadline been running since last week?
I wrote about a pothole and faulty lighting. They filled the pothole but said nothing about the lights. The system says ‘everything completed’.
strings.Я направил запрос бюджета муниципального: I sent a request for the municipal district budget to the district administration because its district name was familiar. The reply said these were not its documents. I need to work out who should actually provide the adopted decision and appendices.
strings.Я направила запрос о том, какие сведения: I asked what information about my child is processed and why. They want to send a table for the whole class in response. I asked for my own child’s data.
strings.Я не разрешал рекламу, но магазин присла: I did not permit advertising, but the shop sent a message saying my paid order was ready for collection. I want to complain specifically about that message.
strings.Я не слышу объявления. На табло мой тало: I cannot hear the announcements. My ticket never appeared on the display. They suggested I come back with a relative, but I want to handle the documents myself.
strings.Я несколько раз писал про освещение. Мне: I wrote several times about lighting. They replied that the lights worked. Now a neighbour has photographed a broken cable elsewhere. I brought fresh materials, but they say correspondence is closed.
strings.Я отправил заявление, а на приёме попрос: I submitted an application, and at the appointment they asked me to verify my identity. I said I had a passport photograph on my phone. They explained that a photo was insufficient for this application method. I consider it an unnecessary requirement.
strings.Я отправил пояснения и скан подтверждени: I sent explanations and a supporting scan. A statement says I now have to wait another three months. Is that really correct?
strings.Я отправил претензию на сайт, где купил: I sent my claim to the website where I bought the ticket. They replied, “Your appeal has been received.” I think the airline’s deadline has already expired, but it gives a different date.
strings.Я письменно попросил справку о своей зар: I requested a salary certificate and a certified copy of my hiring order in writing. They told me to pay for preparing the copies first. Without them it is hard to understand the calculation.
strings.Я пожаловался на открытый люк. Сегодня с: I complained about an open manhole. Today a neighbour says it has been covered. But I still have that photograph on my phone. Does that mean I shouldn’t have written?
strings.Я попросила пристава проверить конкретны: I asked the bailiff to check a specific debtor's account in my proceedings. They sent me the usual thirty-day notification. Is that really just a request for a progress update?
strings.Я пришла пожаловаться на запись к врачу,: I came to complain about getting a doctor's appointment, but I have suddenly become much worse. It is hard to breathe. Can I finish my story first?
strings.Я пришёл в центр рядом с работой. Докуме: I came to the centre near my workplace. They refused my documents and told me to go where I am registered. But this service's page says applications are accepted regardless of residence.
strings.Я проверил учебный центр и не нашёл аккр: I checked the training centre and could not find accreditation. Does that mean it operates without a licence? The contract names one legal entity, while the website shows an attractive shared name.
strings.Я просил исполнение бюджета по программе: I asked for budget implementation under the programme and a list of expenditure. They replied that the original statement contains personal data, so nothing can be provided. But I do not need other people's telephone numbers or bank accounts.
strings.Я снова направил прежний вопрос и те же: I sent the old question and the same attachments again. I have read both responses but still disagree. I have no new information now.
strings.Я согласился получать письма с акциями н: I agreed to receive promotional emails. But they started sending me SMS messages. The shop says it is all the same consent.
strings.Я сообщил о запахе по 104 из безопасного: I reported the smell to 104 from a safe place. The confirmation said block 2, but I had said block 3. While trying to correct it, I came to you with a letter.
strings.Я увидел, что с фасада снимают детали. Д: I saw parts being removed from the facade. The building is protected, so should every such operation be prohibited immediately?
strings.Я увидела сведения о здоровье ребёнка на: I saw my child’s health information on the school-service screen and thought the entire internet could see it. I copied the page address, but my neighbour could not open it.
strings.Я хочу прочитать решение о бюджете нашег: I want to read our municipal district's budget decision and appendices. I found some draft on the website. Do I have to explain why I need these documents? And who provides them—the district administration or the Council of Deputies?
strings.Я шёл сюда мимо газового шкафа и почувст: On my way here I walked past a gas cabinet and noticed a strong smell. I wanted to submit a statement. Could you register it first and have someone look tomorrow?
